name: Bouncing Skull
flavour: It is not done with you.
text: After its blast the skull bounces on twice, turning up to 30° toward the nearest enemy ahead: the first bounce lands 1.6x the blast's radius + 1.5 m on with a 70% blast and cloud, the second 1.2x + 1 m on at 50%.
vfx: the skull hops on twice past its blast, smaller each time
art_prompt: a painted sugar skull bouncing along the sand with motion arcs behind it
